page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g6.13xlarge is a general-purpose cloud instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 52 dedicated vCPUs driven by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz on x86_64 architecture. The server is provisioned with 192.0 GB of memory, yielding approximately 3.69 GB of system RAM per virtual core.

This server instance contains no bundled local disk storage, requiring external network-attached volumes for data persistence. It also lacks integrated GPU accelerators or specialized expansion hardware. Network capabilities include a baseline bandwidth of 12 Gbps, while public IPv4 address assignment is not included by default.

The 1:3.7 vCPU-to-RAM ratio delivers balanced resource allocation suitable for enterprise hosting. The primary technical tradeoff involves reliance on remote storage latency for disk operations. Recommended workload fits include enterprise web applications, container orchestration nodes, CI/CD build servers, and general-purpose backend services.
